title: Garsa Fwip
subtitle: Independent
description: As the proprietor of Garsa's Sanctuary, Garsa Fwip was a well-known figure in the small city of Mos Espa. The stylish and well-dressed Twi-lek was the adored host of her establishment and threw in for Boba Fett's protection early in his assumption of the daimyo role. Her sanctuary became meeting ground, and her allegiance would go on to cost her everything.
